description: We are a Greece–Lithuania team creating EARTH WITHOUT EYES: an accessible instrument that turns NASA Earth visualization frames into explorable sound. Our prototype includes keyboard-controlled spatial listening, transparent image-to-audio mappings, and blind A/B comparisons. We combine software, mathematical reasoning, Earth science and audio design. We welcome accessibility testing and rigorous scientific feedback. Live prototype: https://earth-without-eyes-2026.vercel.app/
